I managed to get the government fertilizer coupon this year, so I will put one fifty-kilogram bag of NPK and one bag of urea on this maize plot — I figure that is about thirty-five kilograms of nitrogen for each hectare. I will also spread two cartloads of manure from my cow before planting, and I will plant the hybrid seed I got from the program. I will not buy chemicals or hire ganyu workers because I do not have the cash. My wife and I will do everything ourselves, from planting and weeding twice to harvesting, which will take us about eighty days in total.
